data.acceptance: hive-cleanup treats terminal tracking statuses as terminal even when deadlineAt is in the future, and does not reclaim live-PID work solely because deadlineAt passed unless the configured stale/busy policy explicitly requires it with evidence. Tests cover terminal tracking plus future deadline, live PID past deadline preserved or classified non-destructively, ESRCH dead still reaped, within-deadline busy preserved, and no regression to H4/H5/H7 prior fixes.
